```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- tibble(features = raw$features) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, regex("\\bAugust\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)))

largest_fires <- fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

## August fires

There are **`r nrow(august_fires)`** records with “August” in the incident name.

## Ten largest fires

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  largest_fires |>
    select(incident, fire_year, state, agency, gis_acres),
  digits = 0,
  col.names = c("Incident", "Year", "State", "Agency", "Acres")
)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fire_shapes <- sf::st_read("data/wildfires.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |>
  mutate(.source_row = row_number()) |>
  filter(
    !sf::st_is_empty(geometry),
    sf::st_geometry_type(geometry) %in% c("POLYGON", "MULTIPOLYGON")
  ) |>
  sf::st_transform(5070) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()

fire_locations <- fire_shapes |>
  mutate(geometry = sf::st_point_on_surface(geometry)) |>
  sf::st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(
    lon = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, "X"],
    lat = sf::st_coordinates(geometry)[, "Y"]
  ) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(.source_row, lon, lat)

big_fires <- fires |>
  mutate(.source_row = row_number()) |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  inner_join(fire_locations, by = ".source_row") |>
  filter(is.finite(lon), is.finite(lat))
```

## Boundaries of the ten largest fires

Fill color represents acreage. Select a fire boundary for its name, year, and acreage.

```{r}
ten_big_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

ten_fire_boundaries <- fire_shapes |>
  filter(.source_row %in% ten_big_fires$.source_row) |>
  sf::st_transform(4326)

map_bounds <- sf::st_bbox(ten_fire_boundaries)
acreage_pal <- colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = ten_fire_boundaries$gis_acres)

leaflet(ten_fire_boundaries) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    color = "#7C2D12",
    weight = 1,
    opacity = 0.85,
    fillColor = ~acreage_pal(gis_acres),
    fillOpacity = 0.4,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", htmltools::htmlEscape(incident), "</strong><br/>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br/>",
      "Acres: ", format(round(gis_acres), big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    pal = acreage_pal,
    values = ~gis_acres,
    title = "Acres burned",
    position = "bottomright",
    labFormat = labelFormat(big.mark = ",", digits = 0)
  ) |>
  fitBounds(
    map_bounds[["xmin"]],
    map_bounds[["ymin"]],
    map_bounds[["xmax"]],
    map_bounds[["ymax"]]
  )
```
